notes.note: Current MatrixDCT uses register/LUT storage. Its new resource and timing fields are pending, not copied from the obsolete BRAM implementation. Latest verified N1024 batch: 43622 cycles. Original hardware reports remain historical evidence.
Keep the latest valid value per test project and configuration. Architecture/pipeline/version names are not separate test projects.
Project, backend under comparison, N, frequency, output lanes, frame count and stall condition identify a case. Inclusive hierarchy scope is retained.

Refresh metrics separately: a 150 MHz resource update does not invent new 50/100 MHz resources. Unchanged metrics use the latest available reports. Runtime cycle counts use the latest matching regression and are converted by frequency.
Source paths in tables and JSON are relative to docs/benchmarks/. Per-metric source columns identify the original evidence; different metric groups can come from different packages.
LUT, FF, BRAM and DSP appear first. DCT/C64/SkewDCT8 hierarchy rows are already included in parent totals.
One BRAM tile is a 36 Kb equivalent; each RAMB18 counts as 0.5 tile.

XFFT resource reports use fixed-size cores and a 10 ns synthesis clock; custom FFT resources use a shared runtime core after routing at 20 ns. The 64..2048 XFFT latency numbers use runtime_2048. These attributes remain source metadata, not version-specific result rows.
Latest reported custom complete-frame latency is 82 cycles; its accompanying regression records 83. The primary table retains the latest reported value and marks this counting discrepancy.
First-output cycles are taken from the latest package reporting that metric (2026-10-22); complete-frame comparisons are updated by the 2026-10-25 package.

Times are RTL cycles divided by MHz, not board/PS/DMA measurements. Four-frame averages are not independently measured single-frame latency or steady-state II. MFCC reference errors do not isolate DCT error or recognition accuracy.
Superseded values remain in immutable original reports for traceability, outside primary tables. The explicit paired memory before/after experiment retains both required comparison sides.
Not measured for the latest RTL. Frozen-route estimate is approximately -1.409 ns. The old 200 MHz run was interrupted during placement and is not a pass/fail result.
